# Laura Clarke Administrative Services

> Independent, private document concierge based in St. Catherine, Jamaica. We pre-audit paperwork against each agency's counter rules and file or collect documents at PICA, TAJ, RGD, JCF and ITA for clients in Jamaica and overseas (US, UK, Canada). We are not a government agency and are not affiliated with the Government of Jamaica. Government fees are paid to the agency and are separate from our service fee. Courier is charged separately and quoted by delivery address.

How to start: new clients send a request through the request page (https://documenthelpja.com/start), choosing the service, or book a consultation (https://documenthelpja.com/#consultation) if their document is not listed. Each service page has an eligibility checklist to read first. Existing and referred clients can WhatsApp +1 (876) 561-2614. Email: info@documenthelpja.com. Requirements and fees on this site were last checked October 2026. Free guides and kits are information only; our paid services are listed below with their fees.

## Services (Dedicated Pages)

- [Jamaican Passport Services](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-passport-services.html): Digital application to renew an adult passport where PICA allows (J$5,000 or US$70 fee). First adult passports, children's passports, renewals with a name change and lost, stolen or damaged passports are applied for on paper by the applicant; the page shows the steps, and a consultation is available (J$5,000 or US$50: 30-minute call, checklist, document review, guidance on the form, follow-up questions for 5 working days; paid by bank transfer after agreeing to the terms; we do not fill in or submit the form). We do not lodge paper applications at PICA for clients.
- [Citizenship by Descent](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-citizenship-application.html): For the diaspora. The steps and documents for claiming citizenship through a Jamaican parent or grandparent; the applicant applies to PICA or a Jamaican mission and pays PICA's fee. A consultation is available (US$50, or J$5,000 in Jamaica).
- [TRN from Overseas](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-trn-application-overseas-diaspora.html): For the diaspora and non-nationals abroad. We complete the TRN form, check the notarised ID, submit in person at TAJ, and send the TRN letter by DHL (US$100 fee; TAJ charges no government fee; optional apostille US$100 plus the Ministry's apostille fee).
- [Driver's Licence Renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/drivers-licence-renewal.html): Traffic ticket and TRN check, Form F7 prepared for signing, and TAJ fee paid online (J$4,000 plus TAJ's fee). The driver collects the card at TAJ in person. Traffic ticket lookup on its own is J$1,500. Replacements for lost or stolen licences are not offered; see the guide.
- [Motor Vehicle Licence Renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/motor-vehicle-licence-renewal.html): Online registration renewal when fitness and insurance are valid, or fitness pre-pay and registration when fitness has expired (J$4,000 plus TAJ's fees, fitness pre-pay included). The owner takes the vehicle to the ITA depot for inspection.
- [Jamaican Driving Abstract](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-driving-abstract.html): Retrieval of the official driving record for overseas licence exchanges, insurers and employers. Authorisation letter stamping, fee payment, collection and DHL dispatch (US$100 plus government fees and courier; optional apostille US$100 plus the Ministry's apostille fee).
- [Jamaican Police Record](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record.html): In Jamaica, we complete the online application, pay the JCF fee and book the fingerprinting appointment (J$5,000 plus JCF fee). Overseas, applicants with a Jamaican TRN are fingerprinted where they live and we submit, collect and apostille the certificate (US$100 plus the JCF fee, stamp duty and the Ministry's apostille fee; returned in the client's prepaid DHL envelope).
- [Birth, Marriage & Death Certificates (RGD)](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-rgd-certificates.html): Certified copy retrieval (from J$3,000 or US$30 plus RGD fee and courier), and record searches when the date or parish is unknown (J$5,000 or US$50 plus RGD's search fee of J$1,000 per decade). RGD takes about 5 working days. Certificates are sent by DHL courier with tracking (the courier charge is added to the RGD order), unless the client chooses to collect in person.
- Apostille (an add-on to the services above, such as RGD certificates, police records, driving abstracts and TRN letters): we take the document to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade for its apostille (US$100 per document, covering the trips, stamp duty and lodging; the Ministry's apostille fee and courier are extra). Note: some countries, such as Nigeria, are not party to the Apostille Convention and need legalisation instead.
- [Free Kits & Checklists](https://documenthelpja.com/free-kits): Free printable PDFs to download, no sign-up: Self-Employed Tax Survival Kit, Tax Backlog Recovery Guide and H-2B Application Toolkit.
- [Request a service](https://documenthelpja.com/start): Choose a service or a consultation, give your details and accept the terms. Laura replies by WhatsApp or email.
- [Digital Business Contact Card](https://documenthelpja.com/card.html): Instant vCard download and WhatsApp connection.

## Guides & Advisory

- [US visitor visa (B1/B2) from Jamaica](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-us-visitor-visa-guide): The DS-160 form, the visa fee, interview day in Kingston and agency red flags. Information only; we do not complete visa applications.
- [H-2B work placement from Jamaica](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-h2b-work-visa-guide): How seasonal U.S. work visas operate, the documents needed, how to check an agency is licensed with the Ministry of Labour, questions to ask and scam red flags, with a free printable toolkit. Information only; we do not recruit or place workers.
- [Birth, marriage and death certificates (RGD) guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-rgd-certificates-guide): Ordering a certified copy, entry numbers, record searches and ordering from overseas.
- [PICA card payment failed](https://documenthelpja.com/pica-card-payment-failed): Why overseas cards are declined on the PICA passport renewal portal, the draft lock, and the 4-step fix.
- [Jamaican police record guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record-guide): Requirements, photo rules, JCF fees and processing times, and applying from overseas.
- [Driver's licence renewal blocked by tickets](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-drivers-license-renewal-guide): Ticket and TRN holds, the 60-day receipt rule, same-day offices, medical rules and replacing a lost licence.
- [TRN with only a birth certificate](https://documenthelpja.com/trn-without-photo-id): The certified photo and declaration route for adults without photo ID, TRNs for children, and applying from overseas.
- [Jamaican passport application & renewal guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-passport-guide): First-time applications, renewals, name changes and lost passports, with PICA's document and photo rules.
- [Citizenship by descent through a Jamaican parent](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-citizenship-by-descent): Who qualifies and the documents PICA requires to prove lineage.
- [Motor vehicle licence renewal guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-motor-vehicle-licence-guide): Insurance, fitness and registration in order, and renewing online.
- [Learner's Permit Complete Step-by-Step Guide](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-learners-permit-guide.html): Form H3A checklist, free ITA Road Code Test booking, J$1,800 TAJ fee, and lost permit replacement (also J$1,800).
- [Self-employed in Jamaica, Episode 1: S04 basics](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-s04-tax-guide): Who has to file, what the S04 and S04a are, the March 15 deadline and quarterly payment dates, with the free Self-Employed Tax Survival Kit to download. Information only; we do not prepare or file tax returns.
- [Episode 2: The self-employed NIS minimum](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-nis-minimum-jamaica): Why a nil S04 still carries about J$13,000 a year in NIS (6% of J$216,666.67), paid J$3,250 a quarter.
- [Episode 3: Traps that grow a TAJ bill](https://documenthelpja.com/self-employed-tax-traps-jamaica): Late-filing penalties, best judgement assessments, interest on missed quarters, NIS gaps and the TCC blockade, and how to catch up.
- [NIS record gaps, voluntary contributions and pensions](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-nis-guide): Closing contribution gaps and avoiding one-off grant traps.
- [C5 travel form and barrel clearance](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-c5-travel-form): Avoid wharf traps and personal effects declaration errors. Information only; we do not offer customs clearance.
